user.title: Configure SmartPI Calculator
user.description: Direct valve control writes valve values and learns with confirmed application. Manual external control learns assuming you apply the output externally 1:1. Learning disabled only calculates: no writes or learning.

valves.title: Direct valve control
valves.description: Select existing opening and closing number entities in matching order and equal counts. For example 40% becomes opening 40 / closing 60. Disable native Adaptive Mode and other writers of these valve values. RoomMind remains the target source.

error.invalid_pairs: Select an equal, nonzero number of opening and closing entities.
error.duplicate_valves: Each valve entity must be unique.
error.valve_in_use: A selected valve already belongs to another SmartPI instance.
error.valve_is_source: A valve output cannot also be a temperature or target source.
error.invalid_valve_range: Valves must support 0–100 with a compatible step size.

abort.already_configured: A calculator for this room temperature source already exists.
